annotations.title: Recommend MCP servers for a task

description: Describe what the user wants to do in plain words. Returns the best three servers, each with why it fits, auth, remote or local, health, and the install snippet for the client.

client.description: The agent the user installs into. grok is Grok Build (terminal) plus grok.com; grok-bot is Grok Bot, which takes a chat message. json returns a plain mcpServers block for any other client.

no_auth.description: Skip servers that need an API key or a sign-in.

official_only.description: Only servers published by the product they connect to.

remote_only.description: Hosted servers only, nothing to install.

verified_only.description: Only servers that passed the live health check.

voice_ready.description: Only servers suited to voice agents.

response_format.description: json (default) or markdown for a human-readable text block. structuredContent is always JSON.

task.description: What the agent should be able to do, for example query my Postgres database or send email from Gmail.

name: recommend_servers

official.description: Published by the product it connects to.
